coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Overseas employment agencies need a licence from the Department of Labour, approved by the supervisory committee; the licence can be refused, suspended or revoked, and running an agency without a licence is punishable by up to 7 years' imprisonment. Agencies must take responsibility for contacting the employer abroad when a worker's rights are infringed, but the Law does not make them jointly liable with the employer.
coded.src: Law Relating to Overseas Employment 1999, Chapters 4–6 · official text: https://www.mol.gov.mm/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1999-OE-law.pdf

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Service fees that the Department and agencies may charge are set under the Law (by the Central Committee, s. 6(g); s. 27 refers to fees set by the supervisory body); an agency that charges more than the fee set has its licence suspended or revoked and faces up to 3 years' imprisonment and a fine. The Law does not prohibit charging workers.
coded.src: Ministry of Labour notifications; Law Relating to Overseas Employment 1999 · official text: https://www.mol.gov.mm/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1999-OE-law.pdf

coded.vi: Kontrak wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori pekerja, atau tanpa syarat minimum atau verifikasi
coded.vl: A contract is required, but only for some categories of workers, or without minimum terms or verification
coded.n: The 1999 Law does not require a written contract; it obliges the agency to carry out the obligations of a contract 'if there is one'. Contract signing between employer and worker before departure is handled administratively: an MOL announcement is titled on employer–worker contract signing and attendance at the overseas employment orientation course (mol.gov.mm post 37806; content not retrieved because the site blocked further access).
coded.src: Law Relating to Overseas Employment 1999 · official text: https://www.mol.gov.mm/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1999-OE-law.pdf

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: The 1999 Law only lets the supervisory body arrange training courses relating to overseas employment; it does not make orientation compulsory. MOL announcement titles refer to an overseas employment orientation course required in connection with contract signing and the Overseas Worker Identification Card (OWIC) (posts 37806, 35420, 34871; contents not retrieved).

coded.vi: Tidak ada dana atau asuransi wajib
coded.vl: No statutory fund or compulsory insurance
coded.n: The 1999 Law creates no welfare fund and no compulsory insurance for overseas workers; it gives the worker a right to claim, through the agency, compensation for work injury abroad.
coded.src: Law Relating to Overseas Employment 1999 · official text: https://www.mol.gov.mm/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1999-OE-law.pdf

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
coded.n: Labor attachés are posted in some destinations by administrative decision.

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: The Department supervises agencies and the supervisory body can suspend or revoke licences; the worker may sue in civil or criminal courts for loss of rights relating to overseas employment. No specialized body awards compensation.
coded.src: Law Relating to Overseas Employment 1999 · official text: https://www.mol.gov.mm/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1999-OE-law.pdf

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
coded.vl: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
coded.n: The Central Committee designates the countries, organizations and types of work for which overseas employment is not permitted, and the Department may stop a worker found unfit by the medical board from leaving; these powers are sex-neutral on their face.
coded.src: Ministry of Labour announcements, 2014 and 2024 (to check) · official text: https://www.mol.gov.mm/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1999-OE-law.pdf

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: The 1999 Law makes the systematic re-use at home of experience and skills gained abroad an objective and a duty of the Central Committee to guide and supervise, but it assigns no body a duty to provide reintegration services.
